title: Google Trekker at Mackinnon Pass in mist, published 2015
credit: Department of Conservation; the accompanying account credits Peter Hiemstra with photographing the fieldwork.
altText: A silhouetted operator carrying the Google Trekker camera in mist at Mackinnon Pass on the Milford Track.
caption: Google Trekker operator Matt Jenke at Mackinnon Pass on the Milford Track. DOC published this field photograph in November 2015; the exact day of capture is unstated.
dateDisplay: Published 6 November 2015; exact capture date unstated
context: DOC’s own account documents the named Street View field programme, the people and tracks. Its footer links to DOC’s Crown-copyright CC BY 4.0 policy. No separate third-party copyright notice appears on these photographs.
